title: I made a cozy forest brawler where you juggle boars into the air. Free browser demo
author: tooavg
selftext:
Hi! Bonkwood is my solo project: a 2D platform brawler with a Brawlhalla-style combat feel. Launch enemies into the air, juggle them, slam them back down, and learn each boss’s moves.

* 5 forest levels, each ending in a boss arena
* 7 weapons, each with its own mechanic, plus 3 talent trees
* 3 lives per run: lose them all and you lose everything except your bank

Plays straight in your browser, no download needed: [**vestom.itch.io/bonkwood**](http://vestom.itch.io/bonkwood)

I’d love honest feedback, especially on how the combat feels and how hard the bosses are. Where did you get bored or stuck?
